intro: Nitroglycerin is a volatile chemical substance carried by dwarven soldiers and officers garrisoned at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. It serves as an industrial explosive agent for their excavation operations, though it can also be turned against them.

p: The Bael'dun dwarves tore into the ancestral lands of the Stonespire tauren using heavy mechanical drillers and volatile chemistry. To blast holes deep into the ground and tear apart the hills, dwarven personnel at the Bael Modan excavation site and its fortified keep keep stores of raw nitroglycerin close at hand. Both frontline soldiers and officers such as Lord Cyrik Blackforge carry vials of the volatile fluid on their persons to fuel the ongoing, destructive digging.
